results.question: Compare my spending in May 2025 with April 2025.

  CASE
    WHEN T1.booked_on BETWEEN '2025-05-01' AND '2025-05-31'

    ELSE 'April 2025'
  END AS period,
  ROUND(-SUM(T1.amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view AS T1
WHERE
  T1.amount < 0
  AND (
    T1.booked_on BETWEEN '2025-05-01' AND '2025-05-31'
    OR T1.booked_on BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-04-30'
  )
GROUP BY
  period
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 200

results.question: Compare how much I spent at Doener Haus Kreuzberg between the first half of 2025 and the second half.

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30'
    THEN 'first half of 2025'
    ELSE 'second half of 2025'
  END AS period,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0
  AND LOWER(description || ' ' || COALESCE(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%döner haus kreuzberg%'
  AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  period
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 200
